name: foundry-module-ts

scripts.test: npm run test:pure && npm run test:chat-card && npm run test:packs

scripts.test:chat-card: node test/chat-card.mjs && node test/chat-hook.mjs && node test/riff-editor.mjs && node test/groove-sheet.mjs
